plots.title: Historical Stage-4 anchor
plots.caption: Context-only Local macro F1 on the historical eight-cell audit. These rows are never ranked with current common-population results.
legend: Gray/context styling = not rankable with current results
plots.bootstrap_definition: Metric points only; paired uncertainty is in PLOT_P0_BRIDGE_FOREST.
plots.selection_rule: All context metrics bound to the frozen Stage-4 aggregate artifact.

plots.title: Variant development lineage
plots.caption: Edges encode registered parent relationships; columns are phases, node fill is decision, and border style is evidence status.
plots.bootstrap_definition: not applicable
plots.selection_rule: Every registered variant; deterministic phase-column layout.

plots.title: Phase 0 one-factor bridge
plots.caption: Sequential score changes from the checksum-equivalent historical replay to the current common-population contract.
legend: Adjacent states differ by one factor
plots.bootstrap_definition: Paired intervals are shown separately in PLOT_P0_BRIDGE_FOREST.
plots.selection_rule: All completed P0 bridge states in registered order.

plots.title: Phase 0 paired bridge deltas
plots.caption: Each point changes exactly one bridge factor; context-only historical contrasts remain visually separate.
plots.bootstrap_definition: 20,000 paired source-question grouped draws for completed bridge edges; historical row uses its frozen grouped interval.
plots.selection_rule: All registered P0 contrasts; context-only rows cannot support promotion.

plots.title: P0-S1 prediction-flip audit
plots.caption: Deterministic counts of unchanged and changed ProcessBench decisions after changing only the step reducer.
plots.bootstrap_definition: Not applicable; these are exact paired prediction-transition counts over 1270 scorer rows.
plots.selection_rule: Every flip category emitted by the hash-frozen P0-S1 runner including NO_FLIP.

plots.title: Phase 1 ProcessBench baselines
plots.caption: Common-row first-error macro F1 for R0-R4 under one threshold and evaluator contract.
plots.bootstrap_definition: 20,000 source-question grouped draws.
plots.selection_rule: All completed rankable P1 ProcessBench references.

plots.title: Phase 1 PRMBench score-only references
plots.caption: Every-step AUROC/AUPRC on error responses; never pooled with ProcessBench F1.
legend: Separate marker series = AUROC and AUPRC
plots.bootstrap_definition: 20,000 source-response grouped draws when intervals are registered.
plots.selection_rule: All completed rankable P1 PRMBench references.

plots.title: Phase 1 ProcessBench model x dataset cells
plots.caption: Per-cell macro F1; missing and non-rankable values remain gray, never zero.
plots.bootstrap_definition: Per-cell descriptive panel; inference remains grouped at source-question level.
plots.selection_rule: All completed P1 ProcessBench cell rows.

plots.title: Phase 2 atomic deltas
plots.caption: Each candidate minus the strongest frozen Phase-1 same-access reference.
plots.bootstrap_definition: 20,000 paired source-question draws with simultaneous or Holm-adjusted inference.
plots.selection_rule: Every attempted P2 primary contrast; raw best remains labelled selection-opened.

plots.title: Phase 2 promotion gates
plots.caption: A candidate promotes only when every required gate passes; missing gates are not passes.
plots.bootstrap_definition: Gate rows reference the registered inferential outputs.
plots.selection_rule: All required P2 gates for every attempted candidate.

plots.title: Exact-error versus clean-abstention change
plots.caption: Shows whether an F1 change is driven by error placement or by the clean decision.
plots.bootstrap_definition: Component deltas use the same paired source-question draws.
plots.selection_rule: Completed P2 candidates with both component metrics.

plots.title: Phase 2 reducer deltas versus step top-five
plots.caption: Reducer-only and survivor-gated transform contrasts with representation, detector, threshold, population, and spans held fixed. Raw best remains selection-opened until multiplicity control.
legend: Line = simultaneous or Holm-aware paired 95% interval
Raw best is not automatically supported
plots.comparison_group: exact P2 reducer ProcessBench comparison group with frozen threshold
plots.bootstrap_definition: 20,000 paired whole-source-question draws with simultaneous intervals or Holm-adjusted one-sided inference across opened reducer contrasts.
plots.selection_rule: Every opened Stage-A and eligible Stage-B contrast versus P2R_A_TOPK5_REFERENCE; parent contrasts remain separately registered.

plots.title: Reducer performance by true first-error step length
plots.caption: Macro F1 on erroneous questions stratified by calibration-frozen short, medium, and long true first-error token spans. Clean traces remain in the abstention panel.
legend: Columns = short / medium / long calibration-frozen strata
Missing or single-class = gray, never zero
plots.comparison_group: exact P2 reducer ProcessBench step-length strata
plots.bootstrap_definition: Strata are descriptive slices of the same grouped evaluation; promotion inference remains whole-question paired and multiplicity-aware.
plots.selection_rule: All completed reducer candidates with registered step_length_stratum rows; selected-step-length distributions are reported separately in the appendix.

plots.title: Phase 3 fusion versus strongest parent
plots.caption: A complex fusion must improve on its best atomic parent, not merely the original baseline.
plots.bootstrap_definition: 20,000 paired source-question grouped draws.
plots.selection_rule: Every attempted P3 fusion-parent contrast.

plots.title: Performance versus representation size
plots.caption: Makes the price of fusion visible instead of rewarding a larger feature vector for a negligible gain.
plots.bootstrap_definition: Uncertainty is reported in the paired contrast panel.
plots.selection_rule: All completed P3 variants and their atomic parents.

plots.title: ProcessBench versus PRMBench transfer
plots.caption: Task deltas remain separate axes; specialist quadrants are explicit and no combined score is computed.
legend: Guard lines define universal and specialist regions
plots.comparison_group: separate exact P4 task comparison groups
plots.bootstrap_definition: Each task retains its own paired grouping and interval.
plots.selection_rule: ProcessBench-frozen variants with both task contrasts.

plots.title: PRMBench error-family transfer
plots.caption: Per-family AUROC deltas expose task-specific failures that an overall score can hide.
legend: Line = paired response-group interval when defined
plots.bootstrap_definition: 20,000 paired response-group draws per evaluable family.
plots.selection_rule: All evaluable PRMBench families; single-class families remain explicit status rows.

plots.title: PRMBench original source strata
plots.caption: Original prm_train and prm_test identifiers are shown separately because the frozen overall panel combines both.
plots.bootstrap_definition: 20,000 paired response-group draws inside each source stratum.
plots.selection_rule: Both original source strata; neither is called fresh confirmation.

plots.title: Causal early-detection budget curves
plots.caption: Outcome discrimination and warning behavior at fixed observed-token budgets.
legend: Separate series = AUROC, false-warning rate, declaration accuracy
plots.bootstrap_definition: Paired source-question grouped draws at each fixed budget.
plots.selection_rule: Budgets 64 and 128 for the frozen causal candidate and incumbent.

plots.title: Causal validity checks
plots.caption: Suffix invariance and forbidden-future-access checks are hard gates, not descriptive diagnostics.
plots.bootstrap_definition: not applicable for exact invariance checks
plots.selection_rule: Every required P5 causal gate.

plots.title: Worst-cell and worst-family behavior
plots.caption: Promotion is never justified by a favorable mean that hides a severe cell or family regression.
plots.bootstrap_definition: Worst-unit point values accompany, but do not replace, paired intervals.
plots.selection_rule: All completed promotion-eligible contrasts with a registered worst unit.
